main.description: Ingest open-source vulnerabilities from osv.dev into vertex_cve_entry. Optionally restricted to a single OSV ecosystem (npm / PyPI / crates.io / Maven / Go / RubyGems / Hex / NuGet / Packagist / Pub / cargo) for incremental refresh. Synthesizes affected_purl_pattern (e.g. pkg:cargo/serde@%) per affected package. Idempotent: same vulnerability id overwrites by PK.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem name. Omit for all. See https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/#affectedpackage-field

modifiedSince.description: ISO-8601 timestamp. Only ingest vulnerabilities modified after this time.
